query: We want to build a strategic plan for our Court Services Branch unit, and we already have a bunch of active projects and notes from our directors Chris and Jessica. Where do we start?
expected_behavior: Resolves the strategy folder first and reports in plain language what already exists versus what is missing

If this is a first run, asks where to save and offers three starting paths: top-down interview, bottom-up from existing items, or import notes; if returning, offers the short menu (continue, update, alignment or measures, revisit, visuals)
Hands pasted projects and notes to triaging-new-items instead of classifying commitment itself
Creates or updates 00-planning-session-status.md only after confirmation

query: Where did we leave off in our strategy registers, and what is our next 15-minute step?
expected_behavior: Reads strategy/00-planning-session-status.md and strategy/01 through 11 to summarize stage completion across the 6 TOGAF ADM-aligned stages
Highlights open assumptions (ASM-X), pending idea promotion gates (IDEA-X), and active dispensations (DSP-X)
Recommends one concrete next step and specialist skill in B.C. Government sentence case with zero emoji

query: We just had a quarterly strategy check-in. Leadership shifted priority toward digital registry self-service, Kyron raised a new concern from court clerks, we have 2 new automation ideas, and Initiative WORK-003 hit a privacy review blocker. Update our registers.
expected_behavior: Routes the leadership priority shift to the Org Hierarchy & Context register (tagging Confirmed vs. Interpreted)
Updates the Stakeholder Map with the court clerks' concern, appends the 2 new ideas to the Idea Inventory as 'raw', and updates WORK-003 status/blocker in the Work Inventory
Preserves existing record IDs, logs the changes in the Register Update Changelog, and flags ripple impacts on risks and roadmap gates

query: Document our upward alignment from our Team level through Division, Court Services Branch (CSB), Ministry of Attorney General, and BC Government.
expected_behavior: Populates the 5-tier organizational hierarchy register (Tier 1 Province of BC, Tier 2 Ministry of AG, Tier 3 CSB, Tier 4 Division, Tier 5 Team)
Links team strategic objectives (OBJ-X) upward through each tier without inventing undocumented mandates

query: Assumption ASM-002 (that central IT would fund the license) was just invalidated. Update our registers.
expected_behavior: Updates ASM-002 status to 'Invalidated' in the Constraints, Assumptions & Risks register
Identifies which candidate ideas (IDEA-X), active work items (WORK-X), or roadmap gates depend on ASM-002 and flags them for leadership decision

query: We have meeting notes from leadership (Chris and Jessica) and a stakeholder list from Kyron. Build our Strategic Context Brief and Stakeholder Map.
expected_behavior: Separates confirmed leadership statements from team interpretations and unverified assumptions
Populates the Stakeholder Map with influence, impact, concerns, desired outcomes, and tensions between players
Logs missing baselines and unproven claims in the Assumptions & Evidence Register without inventing facts

query: Summarize our branch's current state from these staff workshop notes without jumping into project recommendations.
expected_behavior: Categorizes current state across services, processes, information/technology, workforce, and governance
Tags claims as Evidence-Backed or Anecdotal
Refrains from prescribing technology solutions or project backlogs

query: Apply a public-sector justice lens to our current-state context and stakeholder map.
expected_behavior: Addresses legislative/policy mandates, judicial and operational independence, and access to justice
Includes Indigenous reconciliation commitments, privacy/records management, and procedural fairness considerations
Identifies cross-ministry and external justice partner dependencies

query: Here are our draft objectives: 1) Build an AI search bot, 2) Migrate files to SharePoint Online, 3) Improve access to court scheduling information. Refine these and build a Strategy on a Page.
expected_behavior: Detects that 'Build an AI search bot' and 'Migrate files to SharePoint Online' are activities/solutions rather than strategic objectives
Reframes them into outcome-oriented strategic objectives while suggesting the specific solutions be logged in the Idea or Work Inventory
Produces a Strategy on a Page with vision, operating principles, outcome objectives, and expected public/operational value

query: Draft a working Strategic Vision Brief for leadership discussion with Chris and Jessica.
expected_behavior: Includes current-to-future state shifts, operating principles (Statement, Rationale, Implications), and outcome objectives
Preserves constraints and unvalidated assumptions rather than inventing baseline metrics
Aligns team vision explicitly beneath broader leadership direction

query: Map the benefits for our strategic objectives across public-sector value dimensions.
expected_behavior: Covers public/democratic value, service value, operational/workforce value, risk/compliance reduction, and stewardship
Connects each benefit to required capabilities and organizational change in the Benefits Dependency Map

query: Create a Shared Vision Model canvas for our Court Administration Transformation program like the CATS business case example.
expected_behavior: Structures the canvas across the 8 public-sector dimensions (For, Who Need, This, Through, Will Enable, Which Support, Unlike, So As To Be)
Captures distinct target group needs for citizens, frontline practitioners, and the Judiciary
Separates controllable application outputs from measurable investment outcomes (increases and decreases)
Aligns upward with Ministry of Justice Service Plan goals and corporate access to justice priorities

query: We have 4 strategic objectives for our branch. Help us define the required business capabilities and avoid turning them into a software shopping list.
expected_behavior: Defines solution-agnostic business capabilities (what the organization must be able to do) linked to each strategic objective
Reframes any tool-specific suggestions into enduring capabilities
Evaluates current vs. target maturity (0-5) across People, Process, Information, Technology, and Governance

query: Assess our capability gaps for 'Evidence-Based Service Design' and 'Cross-Agency Information Sharing' and determine how we should source them.
expected_behavior: Breaks down each capability gap across the five capability dimensions (People, Process, Information, Technology, Policy/Governance)
Classifies disposition as Strengthen Existing, Create Net-New, Leverage Shared/Cross-Ministry, or Obtain Externally
Flags where capabilities have no supporting ideas or active work items

query: Review our draft capability list: '1. SharePoint Team, 2. PowerBI Dashboards, 3. Intake Triage'. Fix any naming anti-patterns.
expected_behavior: Identifies 'SharePoint Team' (org unit/tool) and 'PowerBI Dashboards' (software tool) as capability naming anti-patterns
Rewrites them into stable noun-phrase business capabilities
Populates the Capability Map & Gap Assessment template

query: Compare our Strategic Vision Brief, Capability Map, Idea Inventory, and Work Inventory to surface misalignments and gaps.
expected_behavior: Builds the End-to-End Traceability Matrix connecting Leadership Direction, Objectives, Capabilities, Ideas, Work, and Measures
Runs all 8 diagnostic checks (orphaned work, unsupported objectives, unaddressed capabilities, unevaluated ideas, duplicate ideas, duplicate work, shadow ops, and ideas treated as commitments)
Provides concrete stop, pause, combine, or promote recommendations for leadership

query: Assess the strategic and public-sector risks for our branch strategy and active portfolio.
expected_behavior: Evaluates risks across Strategic, Policy/Legislative, Privacy/Security, Judicial/Operational Independence, Workforce, Dependency, and Delivery categories
Separates fixed constraints and unvalidated assumptions from probabilistic risks
Assigns likelihood, severity, mitigation guardrails, and risk owners in the Strategic Risk Register

query: Two sub-teams have active projects building similar intake trackers while Objective OBJ-3 has zero supporting work. Document this in an alignment audit.
expected_behavior: Flags the two intake tracker projects under Diagnostic Check #6 (Duplicate Active Work Across Teams)
Flags OBJ-3 under Diagnostic Check #2 (Unsupported Strategic Objective)
Recommends consolidating the duplicate work and commissioning discovery or idea promotion for OBJ-3

query: Create a Success Measures Register for our 3 strategic objectives, even though we don't have baseline numbers for two of them yet.
expected_behavior: Defines Outcome Measures, Leading Indicators, and Guardrail Measures for each objective
Marks missing baselines honestly as 'Baseline Needed' rather than inventing numbers
Specifies evidence sources, owners, and review cadences

query: We want to measure speed of public inquiry turnaround. Make sure our measures don't incentivize cutting corners on privacy or procedural fairness.
expected_behavior: Pairs the turnaround time outcome/leading measures with explicit Guardrail Measures covering procedural fairness, accuracy, and privacy compliance
Records the balanced triad in the Success Measures Register

query: We have never done a strategic plan for our branch and have no files yet. Help us get started.
expected_behavior: Finds no existing strategy folder and treats this as a first run
Asks where to save strategy outputs and where source documents live before writing anything
Offers three starting paths: top-down interview, bottom-up from existing items, or import notes
Creates 00-planning-session-status.md and remembers the chosen folder

query: Continue our strategy. We finished the context interview last month.
expected_behavior: Finds the remembered strategy folder and reads 00-planning-session-status.md
Resumes at the vision step instead of restarting the context interview
Offers the returning menu: continue, update the strategy, alignment or measures, revisit on a cadence, visuals or a deck
Does not list item work as a menu option; a request to log or promote an item goes straight to the matching mode or to triaging-new-items

query: Our top objective changed from faster filing to fewer in-person visits.
expected_behavior: Classifies the change (Re-direction) and updates only the strategy-owned registers after confirmation
Lists every affected record by ID with its owning mode or skill: work items, risks, allocations and roadmap entries
Writes one Open follow-ups row per affected record in 00 instead of editing other skills' sections
Keeps the follow-ups visible until the owning mode or skill applies and logs them

query: ASM-002 (central IT funds the licence) is invalidated.
expected_behavior: Updates the assumption in the strategy-owned section of register 06
Raises follow-ups for every dependent RSK-X and WORK-X rather than converting the assumption into a risk or editing risks directly
Logs a changelog row listing the follow-ups

query: Review our priorities.
expected_behavior: Recognizes the request is ambiguous and asks one short question: objectives and measures, ranking of ideas and projects, or delivery status
Routes to the matching skill and mode after the answer instead of guessing

query: There are two strategy folders on this machine and the remembered path no longer exists.
expected_behavior: Says the remembered path is gone and lists the candidate folders with last-updated dates
Asks which to use or whether to start a new one, and creates nothing before the user answers

query: Start the strategy tool. There is a strategy folder with registers 01 to 11 but no 00 file.
expected_behavior: Adopts the existing registers by creating 00 from what exists
Sets each register's status from the files and continues without restarting the interview

query: Someone in our meeting suggested building an AI transcription summary tool. Log it in our Idea Inventory and stress-test the idea.
expected_behavior: Records the proposal in the Idea Inventory with maturity status 'raw' or 'explored' rather than treating it as committed work
Separates the underlying operational problem from the proposed AI solution
Identifies unproven assumptions, privacy/policy constraints, and the cheapest validation step

query: We have 3 validated ideas supporting Capability CAP-002. Compare them and check if any pass the promotion gate.
expected_behavior: Evaluates the candidates across strategic alignment, public/service value, operational impact, policy/privacy feasibility, and overlap with existing work
Enforces the Promotion Gate Checklist (requiring confirmed sponsor, owner, and capacity commitment before entering the Work Inventory)
Preserves decision rationale for deferred, combined, or rejected ideas

query: Add two early, incomplete ideas from our brainstorming session without forcing RICE scores we don't have evidence for.
expected_behavior: Captures the early ideas in the Idea Inventory with 'raw' maturity status
Allows incomplete fields and avoids fabricating numerical priority scores
Suggests a concrete next step (Clarify, Research, or Consultation)

query: Here is a spreadsheet of 10 items our team is doing or talking about doing. Build our Work Inventory.
expected_behavior: Separates verified committed work (approved initiatives, active experiments, operational duties) from unapproved ideas
Routes unapproved ideas to the Idea Inventory rather than listing them as committed work
Populates the Work Inventory with work type, owner, sponsor, linked objective/capability, deliverables, and status

query: We built a quick prototype six months ago that court registry clerks now use every day, but nobody officially owns or funds it. How should we record it?
expected_behavior: Logs the item in the Work Inventory and flags it explicitly as a Shadow Operation / Unverified Operational Commitment
Highlights the governance, support, and risk gap requiring a formal sponsor and service owner decision

query: Promote approved candidate IDEA-008 into the Work Inventory.
expected_behavior: Verifies sponsor, owner, outcome, and capacity commitment
Creates the Work Inventory entry while preserving traceability to IDEA-008 and the approval reference

query: Evaluate our candidate project proposals using the weighted investment framework and generate a 4-quadrant visual.
expected_behavior: Guides the user interactively through Value / ROI and Ability to Deliver criteria using anchored 0-10 rubrics
Normalizes category weights within each axis to 100% and calculates accurate composite scores
Classifies each proposal into one of the 4 quadrants (Strategic Priorities, Big Bets, Tactical Efficiencies, Deprioritize)
Maintains dual-format scoring ledgers in both JSON and CSV
Generates an executive ranking table and 4-quadrant visual report using B.C. Government Design System styling

query: We want to give more weight to legislative drivers and ministry alignment. Show us how to adjust the weighting before and after.
expected_behavior: Explains category weight adjustments within Value / ROI (e.g., increasing Drivers to 46% and Alignment to 26%) while maintaining a 100-point total
Demonstrates overall axis weighting changes (e.g., 72.5% Value vs 27.5% Delivery)
Re-computes composite rankings and highlights any quadrant shifts

query: Our vendor may withdraw support for the registry platform next year. Log it and decide what we should do.
expected_behavior: Records an RSK-X risk linked to the affected WORK-X and OBJ-X
Asks for likelihood, impact and proximity and records an owner and next review date
Offers a response choice: mitigate, transfer, avoid or accept, with rationale and approver if accepted
If mitigate is chosen, offers to raise a work package under the affected work item

query: Build a Now/Next/Later strategic roadmap from our Work Inventory and show where our 2 candidate ideas fit.
expected_behavior: Places only approved Work Inventory items (WORK-X) as committed initiatives across Now, Next, and Later horizons
Represents the 2 unapproved candidate ideas (IDEA-X) strictly as Decision / Validation Gates rather than committed work
Documents prerequisite capabilities, dependencies, and assumptions to validate before horizon transitions

query: The director approved the kiosk pilot, so put it on the roadmap.
expected_behavior: Records the sponsor and approval date but finds no confirmed capacity
Keeps the item as a decision gate flagged Capacity unconfirmed instead of committed work
States the missing evidence as the gate's exit criterion and offers to check capacity with the team skill

query: Close the open follow-up that says our objective changed and WORK-005 may no longer fit.
expected_behavior: Reviews WORK-005 against the changed objective and records the outcome
Applies any change only to owned sections and logs it in the changelog
Marks the follow-up closed only after the change is applied and logged

query: Help us build a strategy. I have never done this before.
expected_behavior: Opens with a plain-language question or numbered menu, not a request for a finished document
Asks at most two questions per turn and shows progress
Treats "I don't know" as an open item and continues
Shows a recap and asks for confirmation before saving anything

query: Score our four candidate proposals. The top-right one is our favourite but nobody has confirmed anyone's capacity for it.
expected_behavior: Scores proposals one at a time on the 0-10 rubric and shows the quadrant
Places the top-right proposal in Q1 but does not recommend funding or committing it
Holds it as a decision gate flagged Capacity unconfirmed and names the missing evidence
Keeps any existing planning note separate from the recommended action
